verses.text_gb_plain: 弟兄们，我们还请求你们，要敬重那些在你们中间劳苦，并在主里带领你们，劝戒你们的人，
verses.text_big5_plain: 弟兄們，我們還請求你們，要敬重那些在你們中間勞苦，並在主裏帶領你們，勸戒你們的人，

footnotes.zh: 意承认而后尊敬并重视。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意承認而後尊敬並重視。
footnotes.en: 5:12 1 acknowledge Recognize and then render respect and regard for.

footnotes.zh: 这里使徒也许是指在教导上劳苦，并在信徒中领头的长老(提前五17)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏使徒也許是指在教導上勞苦，並在信徒中領頭的長老。（提前五17。）
footnotes.en: 5:12 2 those The apostle was probably referring here to the elders who labor in teaching and take the lead among the believers (1 Tim. 5:17).

footnotes.zh: 带领，主要的不是管辖，乃是在行事上作榜样，使别人可以跟从。长老不仅该在教导上劳苦，也该在行事上作榜样。这榜样能成为他们劝戒人的立场。
footnotes.zh_big5: 帶領，主要的不是管轄，乃是在行事上作榜樣，使別人可以跟從。長老不僅該在教導上勞苦，也該在行事上作榜樣。這榜樣能成為他們勸戒人的立場。
footnotes.en: 5:12 3 take To take the lead is not mainly to rule but to set an example in doing things first, that others may follow. The elders not only should labor in teaching but also should do things as an example. The example may become a ground for their admonishing.

refs.text_gb: 他们使我和你们的灵都畅快。这样的人你们务要赏识。
refs.text_big5: 他們使我和你們的靈都暢快。這樣的人你們務要賞識。
refs.text_en: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Acknowledge therefore such ones.

refs.text_gb: 或作劝勉的，就当忠于劝勉；分授的，就当单纯；带领的，就当殷勤；怜悯人的，就当甘心乐意。
refs.text_big5: 或作勸勉的，就當忠於勸勉；分授的，就當單純；帶領的，就當殷勤；憐憫人的，就當甘心樂意。
refs.text_en: Or he who exhorts, in that exhortation; he who gives, in simplicity; he who leads, in diligence; he who shows mercy, in cheerfulness.

refs.text_gb: 你们要信从那些带领你们的，且要服从；因他们为你们的魂儆醒，好像要交账的人；你们要使他们欢乐地作这事，不至叹息；若叹息，就与你们无益了。

refs.text_en: Obey the ones leading you and submit to them, for they watch over your souls as those who will render an account, that they may do this with joy and not groaning; for this would be unprofitable to you.

verses.text_big5_plain: 又因他們所作的工，在愛裏格外尊重他們；你們也要彼此和睦。

footnotes.en: 5:13 2 at To regard the leading ones and to be at peace with one another is the proper condition of a local church.

refs.text_gb: 在我们的神与父面前，不住地记念你们信心的工作，爱心的劳苦，并对我们主耶稣基督之盼望的忍耐；
refs.text_big5: 在我們的神與父面前，不住的記念你們信心的工作，愛心的勞苦，並對我們主耶穌基督之盼望的忍耐；
refs.text_en: Remembering unceasingly your work of faith and labor of love and endurance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father;

refs.text_gb: 因此你们要在主里欢欢喜喜地接待他，并且要尊重这样的人，
refs.text_big5: 因此你們要在主裏歡歡喜喜的接待他，並且要尊重這樣的人，
refs.text_en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such in honor,

refs.text_gb: 盐本是好的，若失了味，可用什么叫它再咸？你们里面要有盐，并要和平相处。
refs.text_big5: 鹽本是好的，若失了味，可用甚麼叫它再鹹？你們裏面要有鹽，並要和平相處。
refs.text_en: Salt is good, but if the salt becomes unsalty, with what will you restore its saltiness? Have salt in yourselves and be at peace with one another.

verses.text_gb: 弟兄们，我们劝[Cra]你们，要劝戒不[Fn1][Crb]守规矩的人，抚慰灰[Fn2][Crc]心的人，扶持软[Fn3][Crd]弱的人，又要对众人恒[Fn4][Cre]忍。
verses.text_big5: 弟兄們，我們勸[Cra]你們，要勸戒不[Fn1][Crb]守規矩的人，撫慰灰[Fn2][Crc]心的人，扶持軟[Fn3][Crd]弱的人，又要對眾人恆[Fn4][Cre]忍。
verses.text_en: And we exhort you, brothers, Admonish the disorderly, console the fainthearted, sustain the weak, be long-suffering toward all.
verses.text_gb_plain: 弟兄们，我们劝你们，要劝戒不守规矩的人，抚慰灰心的人，扶持软弱的人，又要对众人恒忍。
verses.text_big5_plain: 弟兄們，我們勸你們，要勸戒不守規矩的人，撫慰灰心的人，扶持軟弱的人，又要對眾人恆忍。

footnotes.zh: 或许重在指游手好闲，不肯作工，好管闲事(帖后三11)，未受管教，不受约束，悖逆不服。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或許重在指游手好閒，不肯作工，好管閒事，（帖後三11，）未受管教，不受約束，悖逆不服。
footnotes.en: 5:14 1 disorderly Referring, perhaps, mainly to those who are idle and are unwilling to work, being busybodies (2 Thes. 3:11), undisciplined, unruled, rebellious.

footnotes.zh: 灰心的，直译，小魂的。即心思、意志和情感的度量，狭窄且脆弱的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 灰心的，直譯，小魂的。即心思、意志和情感的度量，狹窄且脆弱的。
footnotes.en: 5:14 2 fainthearted Lit., little-souled; i.e., narrow and feeble in the capacity of mind, will, and emotion.

footnotes.zh: 也许是指一般软弱的人，他们或是在灵、魂、体方面软弱，或是在信心上软弱(罗十四1，十五1)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 也許是指一般軟弱的人，他們或是在靈、魂、體方面軟弱，或是在信心上軟弱。（羅十四1，十五1。）
footnotes.en: 5:14 3 weak Probably referring generally to the weak ones, who are weak either in their spirit or soul or body, or are weak in faith (Rom. 14:1; 15:1).

footnotes.zh: 这含示在地方召会里，不仅不守规矩的人需要劝戒，灰心的人需要抚慰，软弱的人需要扶持，并且所有的肢体或多或少都有难处，需要我们对他们恒忍。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這含示在地方召會裏，不僅不守規矩的人需要勸戒，灰心的人需要撫慰，軟弱的人需要扶持，並且所有的肢體或多或少都有難處，需要我們對他們恆忍。
footnotes.en: 5:14 4 long This implies that in a local church, besides those who are disorderly and need admonishing, those who are little-souled and need consoling, and those who are weak and need sustaining, all the members may be a problem in some way and need us to be long-suffering toward them.

refs.text_gb: 正如你们所知道的，我们怎样劝勉你们，抚慰你们，向你们作见证，待你们每一个人，好像父亲待自己的孩子一样；
refs.text_big5: 正如你們所知道的，我們怎樣勸勉你們，撫慰你們，向你們作見證，待你們每一個人，好像父親待自己的孩子一樣；
refs.text_en: Just as you know how we were to each one of you, as a father to his own children, exhorting you and consoling you and testifying,

refs.text_gb: 还有，弟兄们，我们在主耶稣里请求并劝勉你们，你们既然接受了我们的教训，知道当怎样行，并怎样讨神的喜悦，就要照你们现在所行的，更加充盈超越。
refs.text_big5: 還有，弟兄們，我們在主耶穌裏請求並勸勉你們，你們既然接受了我們的教訓，知道當怎樣行，並怎樣討神的喜悅，就要照你們現在所行的，更加充盈超越。
refs.text_en: Furthermore, brothers, we ask and exhort you in the Lord Jesus that even as you received from us how you ought to walk and please God, even as indeed you do walk, that you abound still more.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，我们在我们主耶稣基督的名里嘱咐你们，凡有弟兄不按规矩、且不照着你们从我们所受的传授而行，就当远离他。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，我們在我們主耶穌基督的名裏囑咐你們，凡有弟兄不按規矩、且不照著你們從我們所受的傳授而行，就當遠離他。
refs.text_en: Now we charge you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you keep away from every brother walking disorderly and not according to the things which were handed down to you and which you received from us.

refs.text_gb: 你们自己原知道，应当怎样效法我们；因为我们在你们中间，未尝不守规矩，
refs.text_big5: 你們自己原知道，應當怎樣效法我們；因為我們在你們中間，未嘗不守規矩，
refs.text_en: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not disorderly among you;

refs.text_gb: 因我们听说，在你们中间有些人不按规矩而行，什么工都不作，反倒好管闲事。
refs.text_big5: 因我們聽說，在你們中間有些人不按規矩而行，甚麼工都不作，反倒好管閒事。
refs.text_en: For we hear of some walking among you disorderly, doing no work at all, but being busybodies.

refs.text_gb: 那忍受罪人这样顶撞自己的，你们要考量比较，免得疲倦灰心。
refs.text_big5: 那忍受罪人這樣頂撞自己的，你們要考量比較，免得疲倦灰心。
refs.text_en: For compare Him who has endured such contradiction by sinners against Himself, so that you may not grow weary, fainting in your souls.

refs.text_gb: 你们竟全然忘了那劝勉的话，就是对你们如同对儿子所讲论的，说，“我儿，你不可轻看主的管教，被祂责备的时候，也不可灰心；
refs.text_big5: 你們竟全然忘了那勸勉的話，就是對你們如同對兒子所講論的，說，“我兒，你不可輕看主的管教，被祂責備的時候，也不可灰心；
refs.text_en: And you have completely forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with sons, "My son, do not regard lightly the discipline of the Lord, nor faint when reproved by Him;

refs.text_gb: 我凡事给你们作了榜样，叫你们知道，必须这样劳苦，扶助软弱的人，并且记念主耶稣的话，祂自己说过，施比受更为有福。
refs.text_big5: 我凡事給你們作了榜樣，叫你們知道，必須這樣勞苦，扶助軟弱的人，並且記念主耶穌的話，祂自己說過，施比受更為有福。
refs.text_en: In all things I have shown you by example that toiling in this way we ought to support the weak and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that He Himself said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

refs.text_gb: 照样，作丈夫的，要按情理与妻子同住，因为她是比你软弱的器皿，是女性；又要按她应得的分敬重她，因为她是与你一同承受生命之恩的，好叫你们的祷告不受拦阻。
refs.text_big5: 照樣，作丈夫的，要按情理與妻子同住，因為她是比你軟弱的器皿，是女性；又要按她應得的分敬重她，因為她是與你一同承受生命之恩的，好叫你們的禱告不受攔阻。
refs.text_en: Husbands, in like manner dwell together with them according to knowledge, as with the weaker, female vessel, assigning honor to them as also to fellow heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

crossrefs.label: e
crossrefs.raw: 林前十三4，弗四2，西三12，提后四2

refs.text_gb: 爱是恒久忍耐，又有恩慈；爱是不嫉妒；爱是不自夸，不张狂，
refs.text_big5: 愛是恆久忍耐，又有恩慈；愛是不嫉妒；愛是不自誇，不張狂，
refs.text_en: Love suffers long. Love is kind; it is not jealous. Love does not brag and is not puffed up;

refs.text_gb: 凡事卑微、温柔、恒忍，在爱里彼此担就，
refs.text_big5: 凡事卑微、溫柔、恆忍，在愛裏彼此擔就，
refs.text_en: With all lowliness and meekness, with long-suffering, bearing one another in love,

refs.text_gb: 所以你们既是神的选民，圣别蒙爱的人，就要穿上怜恤的心肠、恩慈、卑微、温柔、恒忍。
refs.text_big5: 所以你們既是神的選民，聖別蒙愛的人，就要穿上憐恤的心腸、恩慈、卑微、溫柔、恆忍。
refs.text_en: Put on therefore, as God's chosen ones, holy and beloved, inward parts of compassion, kindness, lowliness, meekness, long-suffering;

refs.text_gb: 务要传道；无论得时不得时，都要预备好，用全般的恒忍和教训，叫人知罪自责，谴责人，劝勉人。
refs.text_big5: 務要傳道；無論得時不得時，都要豫備好，用全般的恆忍和教訓，叫人知罪自責，譴責人，勸勉人。
refs.text_en: Proclaim the word; be ready in season and out of season; convict, rebuke, exhort with all long-suffering and teaching.

verses.text_gb: 你们要当心，谁都不可以恶[Cra]报恶，却要在彼[Crb]此相待，或对待众人上，常[Fn1]常竭力追求良[Crc]善。
verses.text_big5: 你們要當心，誰都不可以惡[Cra]報惡，卻要在彼[Crb]此相待，或對待眾人上，常[Fn1]常竭力追求良[Crc]善。
verses.text_en: See that no one repays anyone evil for evil, but always pursue what is good both for one another and for all.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们要当心，谁都不可以恶报恶，却要在彼此相待，或对待众人上，常常竭力追求良善。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要當心，誰都不可以惡報惡，卻要在彼此相待，或對待眾人上，常常竭力追求良善。

footnotes.zh: 意即别人无论怎样待我们，即使是恶待，我们在对待他们上，也该竭力追求良善。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意即別人無論怎樣待我們，即使是惡待，我們在對待他們上，也該竭力追求良善。
footnotes.en: 5:15 1 always This means that regardless of how others treat us, even if their treatment is evil, we should pursue what is good for them.

refs.text_gb: 不要以恶报恶，要准备在众人面前作善美的事。
refs.text_big5: 不要以惡報惡，要準備在眾人面前作善美的事。
refs.text_en: Repay no one evil for evil; take forethought for things honorable in the sight of all men.

refs.text_gb: 不以恶报恶，或以辱骂还辱骂，倒要祝福，因你们是为此蒙召，好叫你们承受福分。
refs.text_big5: 不以惡報惡，或以辱罵還辱罵，倒要祝福，因你們是為此蒙召，好叫你們承受福分。
refs.text_en: Not rendering evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary blessing one another, because you were called to this, that you might inherit blessing.

refs.text_gb: 但是我告诉你们，不要抗拒恶人；反而无论谁打你的右脸，连另一面也转给他。
refs.text_big5: 但是我告訴你們，不要抗拒惡人；反而無論誰打你的右臉，連另一面也轉給他。
refs.text_en: But I tell you not to resist him who is evil; rather whoever slaps you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

refs.text_gb: 所以你们要彼此安慰，互相建造，正如你们一向所行的。
refs.text_big5: 所以你們要彼此安慰，互相建造，正如你們一向所行的。
refs.text_en: Therefore comfort one another, and build up each one the other, even as you also do.

refs.text_gb: 又愿主使你们彼此的爱并对众人的爱，都能增多洋溢，正如我们对你们一样；
refs.text_big5: 又願主使你們彼此的愛並對眾人的愛，都能增多洋溢，正如我們對你們一樣；
refs.text_en: And the Lord cause you to increase and abound in love to one another and to all, just as we also to you,

refs.text_gb: 但要凡事察验，善美的要持守，
refs.text_big5: 但要凡事察驗，善美的要持守，
refs.text_en: But prove all things. Hold fast to what is good;

refs.text_gb: 我的弟兄们，我自己也深信你们是满有良善，充满了各样的知识，也能彼此劝戒。
refs.text_big5: 我的弟兄們，我自己也深信你們是滿有良善，充滿了各樣的知識，也能彼此勸戒。
refs.text_en: But I myself also am persuaded concerning you, my brothers, that you yourselves also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

refs.text_gb: 但那灵的果子，就是爱、喜乐、和平、恒忍、恩慈、良善、信实、
refs.text_big5: 但那靈的果子，就是愛、喜樂、和平、恆忍、恩慈、良善、信實、
refs.text_en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, long-suffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

verses.text_gb: 要[Fn1]常常喜[Cra]乐，
verses.text_big5: 要[Fn1]常常喜[Cra]樂，
verses.text_en: Always rejoice,
verses.text_gb_plain: 要常常喜乐，
verses.text_big5_plain: 要常常喜樂，

footnotes.zh: 这是基于14～15节所说的光景。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是基於14～15節所說的光景。
footnotes.en: 5:16 1 Always This is based on the conditions mentioned in vv. 14-15.

refs.text_gb: 你们要在主里常常喜乐，我再说，你们要喜乐。
refs.text_big5: 你們要在主裏常常喜樂，我再說，你們要喜樂。
refs.text_en: Rejoice in the Lord always; again I will say, rejoice.

refs.text_gb: 末了，弟兄们，要喜乐，要被成全，要受安慰，要思念相同的事，要和睦，如此那爱与和平的神，必与你们同在。
refs.text_big5: 末了，弟兄們，要喜樂，要被成全，要受安慰，要思念相同的事，要和睦，如此那愛與和平的神，必與你們同在。
refs.text_en: Finally, brothers, rejoice, be perfected, be comforted, think the same thing, be at peace; and the God of love and peace will be with you.

verses.text_gb: 不[Fn1]住地祷[Cra]告，
verses.text_big5: 不[Fn1]住的禱[Cra]告，
verses.text_en: Unceasingly pray,
verses.text_gb_plain: 不住地祷告，
verses.text_big5_plain: 不住的禱告，

footnotes.zh: 即在我们的灵里，与神有不间断的交通。这需要用刚强的灵(弗六18)坚定持续(罗十二12，西四2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即在我們的靈裏，與神有不間斷的交通。這需要用剛強的靈（弗六18）堅定持續。（羅十二12，西四2。）
footnotes.en: 5:17 1 Unceasingly This is to have uninterrupted fellowship with God in our spirit. It requires perseverance (Rom. 12:12; Col. 4:2) with a strong spirit (Eph. 6:18).

crossrefs.label: a
crossrefs.raw: 路十八1，罗十二12，弗六18，彼前四7

refs.text_gb: 耶稣又对他们讲一个比喻，是要人常常祷告，不可灰心，说，
refs.text_big5: 耶穌又對他們講一個比喻，是要人常常禱告，不可灰心，說，
refs.text_en: And He told them a parable to the end that they ought always to pray and not lose heart,

refs.text_gb: 在指望中要喜乐，在患难中要忍耐，在祷告上要坚定持续，
refs.text_big5: 在指望中要喜樂，在患難中要忍耐，在禱告上要堅定持續，
refs.text_en: Rejoice in hope; endure in tribulation; persevere in prayer.

refs.text_gb: 时时在灵里祷告，并尽力坚持，在这事上儆醒，且为众圣徒祈求，
refs.text_big5: 時時在靈裏禱告，並盡力堅持，在這事上儆醒，且為眾聖徒祈求，
refs.text_en: By means of all prayer and petition, praying at every time in spirit and watching unto this in all perseverance and petition concerning all the saints,

refs.text_gb: 但万物的结局已经临近了，所以要清明适度，并且要谨慎自守，以便祷告。
refs.text_big5: 但萬物的結局已經臨近了，所以要清明適度，並且要謹慎自守，以便禱告。
refs.text_en: But the end of all things has drawn near. Therefore be sober-minded and be sober unto prayers.

verses.text_gb: 凡[Fn1]事谢[Fn2][Cra]恩；因[Fn3]为这是神在基督耶稣里对你们的旨[Crb]意。
verses.text_big5: 凡[Fn1]事謝[Fn2][Cra]恩；因[Fn3]為這是神在基督耶穌裏對你們的旨[Crb]意。
verses.text_en: In everything give thanks; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡事谢恩；因为这是神在基督耶稣里对你们的旨意。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡事謝恩；因為這是神在基督耶穌裏對你們的旨意。

footnotes.zh: 这是因为万有都互相效力，叫我们得益处，使我们得以变化，模成基督的形像(罗八28～29)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是因為萬有都互相效力，叫我們得益處，使我們得以變化，模成基督的形像。（羅八28～29。）
footnotes.en: 5:18 1 In Because all things work together for our good that we may be transformed and conformed to the image of Christ (Rom. 8:28-29).

footnotes.zh: 直译，感谢。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，感謝。
footnotes.en: 5:18 2 for This clause modifies the three preceding exhortations. God wants us to live a rejoicing, praying, and thanking life. Such a life is a glory to God and a shame to His enemy.

footnotes.zh: 本句是形容前述三项。神要我们过喜乐、祷告、谢恩的生活。这样的生活对神是荣耀，对神的仇敌是羞辱。
footnotes.zh_big5: 本句是形容前述三項。神要我們過喜樂、禱告、謝恩的生活。這樣的生活對神是榮耀，對神的仇敵是羞辱。

refs.text_gb: 凡事要在我们主耶稣基督的名里，时常感谢神与父，
refs.text_big5: 凡事要在我們主耶穌基督的名裏，時常感謝神與父，
refs.text_en: Giving thanks at all times for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to our God and Father,

refs.text_gb: 凡你们所作的，无论是什么，或说话，或行事，都要在主耶稣的名里，借着祂感谢父神。
refs.text_big5: 凡你們所作的，無論是甚麼，或說話，或行事，都要在主耶穌的名裏，藉著祂感謝父神。
refs.text_en: And whatever you do in word or in deed, do all things in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.

refs.text_gb: 神的旨意就是要你们圣别，禁戒淫乱；
refs.text_big5: 神的旨意就是要你們聖別，禁戒淫亂；
refs.text_en: For this is the will of God, your sanctification: that you abstain from fornication;

verses.text_gb: 不[Fn1]要销灭那灵[Cra]，
verses.text_big5: 不[Fn1]要銷滅那靈[Cra]，
verses.text_en: Do not quench the Spirit;
verses.text_gb_plain: 不要销灭那灵，
verses.text_big5_plain: 不要銷滅那靈，

footnotes.zh: 那灵使我们的灵火热(罗十二11)，并使我们的恩赐如火挑旺(提后一6)。所以我们不该销灭祂。
footnotes.zh_big5: 那靈使我們的靈火熱，（羅十二11，）並使我們的恩賜如火挑旺。（提後一6。）所以我們不該銷滅祂。
footnotes.en: 5:19 1 not The Spirit causes our spirit to be burning (Rom. 12:11) and our gifts to be flaming (2 Tim. 1:6). Hence, we should not quench Him.

refs.text_gb: 并且不要叫神的圣灵忧愁，你们原是在祂里面受了印记，直到得赎的日子。
refs.text_big5: 並且不要叫神的聖靈憂愁，你們原是在祂裏面受了印記，直到得贖的日子。
refs.text_en: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed unto the day of redemption.

refs.text_gb: 他们竟悖逆，使主圣别的灵忧愁；祂就转成他们的仇敌，亲自攻击他们；
refs.text_big5: 他們竟悖逆，使主聖別的靈憂愁；祂就轉成他們的仇敵，親自攻擊他們；
refs.text_en: But they rebelled and grieved / His Spirit of holiness; / Therefore He turned to become their enemy; / He fought against them.

verses.text_gb: 不要藐[Fn1]视申[Fn2]言者的话，
verses.text_big5: 不要藐[Fn1]視申[Fn2]言者的話，
verses.text_en: Do not despise prophecies,
verses.text_gb_plain: 不要藐视申言者的话，
verses.text_big5_plain: 不要藐視申言者的話，

footnotes.zh: 意看为无有，轻看。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意看為無有，輕看。
footnotes.en: 5:20 1 despise Count as nothing, lightly esteem.

footnotes.zh: 申言者的话，即申言，指由启示而来的申言，未必是预言(见林前十四1，3～4与该处注)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 申言者的話，即申言，指由啟示而來的申言，未必是豫言。（見林前十四1與註，3～4與註。）
footnotes.en: 5:20 2 prophecies I.e., prophesying, the prophetic speech that issues from a revelation. It does not need to be a prediction (see 1 Cor. 14:1, 3-4 and notes there).

verses.text_gb: 但要凡[Fn1]事察验，善[Cra]美的要持守，
verses.text_big5: 但要凡[Fn1]事察驗，善[Cra]美的要持守，
verses.text_en: But prove all things. Hold fast to what is good;
verses.text_gb_plain: 但要凡事察验，善美的要持守，
verses.text_big5_plain: 但要凡事察驗，善美的要持守，

footnotes.zh: 包括明辨申言者的话(林前十四29)，辨别诸灵(林前十二10)，试证诸灵(约壹四1)，验证何为神的旨意(罗十二2)，并验证何为主所喜悦的(弗五10)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 包括明辨申言者的話，（林前十四29，）辨別諸靈，（林前十二10，）試證諸靈，（約壹四1，）驗證何為神的旨意，（羅十二2，）並驗證何為主所喜悅的。（弗五10。）
footnotes.en: 5:21 1 prove Including to discern prophecies (1 Cor. 14:29), to discern the spirits (1 Cor. 12:10), to test the spirits (1 John 4:1), to prove what is the will of God (Rom. 12:2), and to prove what is well pleasing to the Lord (Eph. 5:10).

refs.text_gb: 你们要当心，谁都不可以恶报恶，却要在彼此相待，或对待众人上，常常竭力追求良善。
refs.text_big5: 你們要當心，誰都不可以惡報惡，卻要在彼此相待，或對待眾人上，常常竭力追求良善。
refs.text_en: See that no one repays anyone evil for evil, but always pursue what is good both for one another and for all.

refs.text_gb: 我们当为自己选择何为是，彼此知道何为善。
refs.text_big5: 我們當為自己選擇何為是，彼此知道何為善。
refs.text_en: Let us choose for ourselves what is right; / Let us know among ourselves what is good.

verses.text_gb: 各[Fn1]种的恶事要远离禁[Cra]作。
verses.text_big5: 各[Fn1]種的惡事要遠離禁[Cra]作。
verses.text_en: Abstain from every kind of evil.
verses.text_gb_plain: 各种的恶事要远离禁作。
verses.text_big5_plain: 各種的惡事要遠離禁作。

footnotes.zh: 种，原文意种类，指任何看见的事物，任何察觉的事物，因此是景象。不是指恶事的外表，乃是指恶事的种类、形状、样式、景象。信徒在信、爱、望里过圣别的生活，应当远离禁作各种各样的恶事。
footnotes.zh_big5: 種，原文意種類，指任何看見的事物，任何察覺的事物，因此是景象。不是指惡事的外表，乃是指惡事的種類、形狀、樣式、景象。信徒在信、愛、望裏過聖別的生活，應當遠離禁作各種各樣的惡事。
footnotes.en: 5:22 1 kind The Greek word means species. It denotes anything in view, anything in perception; hence, a sight. It refers not to the appearance of evil but to the kind, the form, the shape, the sight, of evil. The believers, who live a holy life in faith, love, and hope, should abstain from evil of any kind.

refs.text_gb: 神的旨意就是要你们圣别，禁戒淫乱；
refs.text_big5: 神的旨意就是要你們聖別，禁戒淫亂；
refs.text_en: For this is the will of God, your sanctification: that you abstain from fornication;

verses.text_gb: 且[Fn1]愿和[Fn2][Cra]平的神，亲自全[Fn3]然圣[Fn4][Crb]别你们，又愿你们的灵[Fn5][Crc]、与魂[Crd]、与身[Cre]子得蒙保[Crf]守，在[Fn6]我们主耶稣基督来[Fn7][Crg]临的时候，得以完[Fn8]全，无[Crh]可指摘。
verses.text_big5: 且[Fn1]願和[Fn2][Cra]平的神，親自全[Fn3]然聖[Fn4][Crb]別你們，又願你們的靈[Fn5][Crc]、與魂[Crd]、與身[Cre]子得蒙保[Crf]守，在[Fn6]我們主耶穌基督來[Fn7][Crg]臨的時候，得以完[Fn8]全，無[Crh]可指摘。
verses.text_en: And the God of peace Himself sanctify you wholly, and may your spirit and soul and body be preserved complete, without blame, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.text_gb_plain: 且愿和平的神，亲自全然圣别你们，又愿你们的灵、与魂、与身子得蒙保守，在我们主耶稣基督来临的时候，得以完全，无可指摘。
verses.text_big5_plain: 且願和平的神，親自全然聖別你們，又願你們的靈、與魂、與身子得蒙保守，在我們主耶穌基督來臨的時候，得以完全，無可指摘。

footnotes.zh: “且”字将本节所说神亲自全然圣别我们的祝福，与前节要我们远离禁作各种恶事的嘱咐连接起来。一面我们远离禁作各种恶事，另一面神全然圣别我们。我们与神合作，叫我们过圣别的生活。
footnotes.zh_big5: “且”字將本節所說神親自全然聖別我們的祝福，與前節要我們遠離禁作各種惡事的囑咐連接起來。一面我們遠離禁作各種惡事，另一面神全然聖別我們。我們與神合作，叫我們過聖別的生活。
footnotes.en: 5:23 1 And And conjoins the blessing of God's sanctifying of our entire being, given in this verse, and the charge to abstain from every kind of evil, given in the preceding verse. On the one hand, we abstain from every kind of evil; on the other hand, God sanctifies us wholly. We cooperate with God that we may have a holy living.

footnotes.zh: 和平的神是那圣别人的，祂的圣别带来和平。当我们从里面被祂全然圣别时，就在凡事上与祂与人都有和平(13)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 和平的神是那聖別人的，祂的聖別帶來和平。當我們從裏面被祂全然聖別時，就在凡事上與祂與人都有和平。（13。）
footnotes.en: 5:23 2 God The God of peace is the Sanctifier; His sanctification brings in peace. When we are wholly sanctified by Him from within, we have peace with Him and with man in every way (v. 13).

footnotes.zh: 或，完全，彻底，……达到极点。神全然圣别我们，叫我们全人——灵、魂、体，没有一部分是凡俗或世俗的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，完全，徹底，…達到極點。神全然聖別我們，叫我們全人─靈、魂、體，沒有一部分是凡俗或世俗的。
footnotes.en: 5:23 3 sanctify To set apart, separate unto God, from things common or profane. See note Rom. 1:2 3 and note Rom. 6:19 2 .

footnotes.zh: 即从凡俗或世俗的事物分别归神。见罗一2注3，六19注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即從凡俗或世俗的事物分別歸神。見羅一2註3，六19註2。
footnotes.en: 5:23 4 wholly Or, entirely, thoroughly, to the consummation. God sanctifies us wholly, so that no part of our being, of either our spirit or soul or body, will be left common or profane.

footnotes.zh: 这话有力的指明人有三部分：灵、魂与身体。灵是我们最深的部分，是里面的器官，有神的知觉，使我们能接触神(约四24，罗一9)。魂是我们的自己(比太十六26，路九25)，介于我们的灵与体之间，有自己的知觉，使我们有个格。体是我们外在的部分，是外在的器官，有世界的知觉，使我们能接触物质的世界。体包含魂，魂是装灵的器皿。那是灵的神住在灵里；我们的自己住在魂里；物质的感觉是在体里。神圣别我们，首先借重生得着我们的灵(约三5～6)；其次将祂自己这赐生命的灵，从我们的灵扩展到魂里，浸透并变化魂(罗十二2，林后三18)；最终，经由我们的魂，赐生命给我们必死的身体(罗八11，13)，并且凭着祂生命的大能，将我们的身体改变形状(腓三21)。见来四12注2，12注3。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這話有力的指明人有三部分：靈、魂與身體。靈是我們最深的部分，是裏面的器官，有神的知覺，使我們能接觸神。（約四24，羅一9。）魂是我們的自己，（比太十六26，路九25，）介於我們的靈與體之間，有自己的知覺，使我們有個格。體是我們外在的部分，是外在的器官，有世界的知覺，使我們能接觸物質的世界。體包含魂，魂是裝靈的器皿。那是靈的神住在靈裏；我們的自己住在魂裏；物質的感覺是在體裏。神聖別我們，首先藉重生得著我們的靈；（約三5～6；）其次將祂自己這賜生命的靈，從我們的靈擴展到魂裏，浸透並變化魂；（羅十二2，林後三18；）最終，經由我們的魂，賜生命給我們必死的身體，（羅八11，13，）並且憑著祂生命的大能，將我們的身體改變形狀。（腓三21。）見來四12註2，註3。
footnotes.en: 5:23 5 spirit This word strongly indicates that man is of three parts: spirit, soul, and body. The spirit as our inmost part is the inner organ, possessing God-consciousness, that we may contact God (John 4:24; Rom. 1:9). The soul is our very self (cf. Matt. 16:26; Luke 9:25), a medium between our spirit and our body, possessing self-consciousness, that we may have our personality. The body as our external part is the outer organ, possessing world-consciousness, that we may contact the material world. The body contains the soul, and the soul is the vessel that contains the spirit. In the spirit, God as the Spirit dwells; in the soul, our self dwells; and in the body, the physical senses dwell. God sanctifies us, first, by taking possession of our spirit through regeneration (John 3:5-6); second, by spreading Himself as the life-giving Spirit from our spirit into our soul to saturate and transform our soul (Rom. 12:2; 2 Cor. 3:18); and last, by enlivening our mortal body through our soul (Rom. 8:11, 13) and transfiguring our body by His life power (Phil. 3:21). See note Heb. 4:12 2 and note Heb. 4:12 3 .

footnotes.zh: 或，在我们主耶稣基督的同在(巴路西亚)里。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，在我們主耶穌基督的同在（巴路西亞）裏。
footnotes.en: 5:23 6 complete God not only sanctifies us wholly but also preserves our spirit, soul, and body complete. Wholly is quantitative; complete is qualitative. Quantitatively, God sanctifies us wholly; qualitatively, God preserves us complete, i.e., He keeps our spirit, soul, and body perfect. Through the fall our body was ruined, our soul was contaminated, and our spirit was deadened. In God's full salvation our entire being is saved and made complete and perfect. For this, God is preserving our spirit from any deadening element (Heb. 9:14), our soul from remaining natural and old (Matt. 16:24-26), and our body from the ruin of sin (1 Thes. 4:4; Rom. 6:6). Such a preservation by God and His thorough sanctification sustain us to live a holy life unto maturity that we may meet the Lord in His parousia.

footnotes.zh: 本书每章都以主的再来为结束，这说明著者保罗是生活工作在主的再来跟前，以此为吸引、鼓励、目标并警惕。他不仅自己这样作，也以此勉励所带领的信徒。
footnotes.zh_big5: 本書每章都以主的再來為結束，這說明著者保羅是生活工作在主的再來跟前，以此為吸引、鼓勵、目標並警惕。他不僅自己這樣作，也以此勉勵所帶領的信徒。
footnotes.en: 5:23 7 at Or, in the presence (parousia).

footnotes.zh: 神不仅全然圣别我们，也保守我们的灵、魂、体得以完全。“全然”是指量一面；“完全”是指质一面。在量一面，神要全然圣别我们；在质一面，神要保守我们得以完全，就是要保守我们的灵、魂、体得以完美。因着堕落，我们的体受了败坏，魂受了玷污，灵也死了。在神完全的救恩里，我们全人都要得救，成为完全、完美的。为此，神保守我们的灵脱离死的元素(来九14)，保守我们的魂不再留在天然和老旧里(太十六24～26)，并保守我们的体脱离罪的败坏(四4，罗六6)。神这样的保守，以及祂彻底的圣别，维持我们过圣别的生活，直到成熟，使我们能在主的“巴路西亚”里与祂相会。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神不僅全然聖別我們，也保守我們的靈、魂、體得以完全。“全然”是指量一面；“完全”是指質一面。在量一面，神要全然聖別我們；在質一面，神要保守我們得以完全，就是要保守我們的靈、魂、體得以完美。因著墮落，我們的體受了敗壞，魂受了玷污，靈也死了。在神完全的救恩裏，我們全人都要得救，成為完全、完美的。為此，神保守我們的靈脫離死的元素，（來九14，）保守我們的魂不再留在天然和老舊裏，（太十六24～26，）並保守我們的體脫離罪的敗壞。（四4，羅六6。）神這樣的保守，以及祂徹底的聖別，維持我們過聖別的生活，直到成熟，使我們能在主的“巴路西亞”裏與祂相會。
footnotes.en: 5:23 8 coming Every chapter of this book ends with the coming of the Lord. This shows that the writer, Paul, lived and worked with the Lord's coming before him, taking it as an attraction, an incentive, a goal, and a warning. He not only did this himself but also encouraged the believers under his care to do the same.

refs.text_gb: 末了，弟兄们，要喜乐，要被成全，要受安慰，要思念相同的事，要和睦，如此那爱与和平的神，必与你们同在。
refs.text_big5: 末了，弟兄們，要喜樂，要被成全，要受安慰，要思念相同的事，要和睦，如此那愛與和平的神，必與你們同在。
refs.text_en: Finally, brothers, rejoice, be perfected, be comforted, think the same thing, be at peace; and the God of love and peace will be with you.

refs.text_gb: 神的旨意就是要你们圣别，禁戒淫乱；
refs.text_big5: 神的旨意就是要你們聖別，禁戒淫亂；
refs.text_en: For this is the will of God, your sanctification: that you abstain from fornication;

refs.text_gb: 要你们各人晓得，怎样用圣别和尊贵，持守自己的器皿，
refs.text_big5: 要你們各人曉得，怎樣用聖別和尊貴，持守自己的器皿，
refs.text_en: That each one of you know how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,

refs.text_gb: 神本是在圣别中召了我们，并不是要我们沾染污秽。
refs.text_big5: 神本是在聖別中召了我們，並不是要我們沾染污穢。
refs.text_en: For God has not called us for uncleanness but in sanctification.

refs.text_gb: 主所爱的弟兄们，我们应当常为你们感谢神，因为祂从起初拣选了你们，叫你们借着那灵的圣别，并你们对真理的信，可以得救。
refs.text_big5: 主所愛的弟兄們，我們應當常為你們感謝神，因為祂從起初揀選了你們，叫你們藉著那靈的聖別，並你們對真理的信，可以得救。
refs.text_en: But we ought to thank God always concerning you, brothers beloved of the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning unto salvation in sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth,

refs.text_gb: 求你用真理圣别他们，你的话就是真理。
refs.text_big5: 求你用真理聖別他們，你的話就是真理。
refs.text_en: Sanctify them in the truth; Your word is truth.

refs.text_gb: 我因你们肉体的软弱，就照着人的常情说，你们从前怎样将肢体献给不洁不法作奴仆，以至于不法，现今也要照样将肢体献给义作奴仆，以至于圣别。
refs.text_big5: 我因你們肉體的軟弱，就照著人的常情說，你們從前怎樣將肢體獻給不潔不法作奴僕，以至於不法，現今也要照樣將肢體獻給義作奴僕，以至於聖別。
refs.text_en: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. For just as you presented your members as slaves to uncleanness and lawlessness unto lawlessness, so now present your members as slaves to righteousness unto sanctification.

refs.text_gb: 但现今你们既从罪里得了释放，作了神的奴仆，就有圣别的果子，结局就是永远的生命。
refs.text_big5: 但現今你們既從罪裏得了釋放，作了神的奴僕，就有聖別的果子，結局就是永遠的生命。
refs.text_en: But now, having been freed from sin and enslaved to God, you have your fruit unto sanctification, and the end, eternal life.

refs.text_gb: 马利亚说，我魂尊主为大，
refs.text_big5: 馬利亞說，我魂尊主為大，
refs.text_en: And Mary said, My soul magnifies the Lord,

refs.text_gb: 我灵曾以神我的救主为乐，
refs.text_big5: 我靈曾以神我的救主為樂，
refs.text_en: And my spirit has exulted in God my Savior;

refs.text_gb: 因为神的话是活的，是有功效的，比一切两刃的剑更锋利，能以刺入、甚至剖开魂与灵，骨节与骨髓，连心中的思念和主意都能辨明。

refs.text_en: For the word of God is living and operative and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit and of joints and marrow, and able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华论以色列之话语的默示。铺张诸天、建立地基、造人里面之灵的耶和华说，
refs.text_big5: 耶和華論以色列之話語的默示。鋪張諸天、建立地基、造人裏面之靈的耶和華說，
refs.text_en: The burden of the word of Jehovah concerning Israel. Thus declares Jehovah, who stretches forth the heavens and lays the foundations of the earth and forms the spirit of man within him,

refs.text_gb: 但在人里面有灵，全能者的气使人有聪明。
refs.text_big5: 但在人裏面有靈，全能者的氣使人有聰明。
refs.text_en: But there is a spirit in man, / And the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.

refs.text_gb: 人的灵是耶和华的灯，鉴察人的深处。
refs.text_big5: 人的靈是耶和華的燈，鑒察人的深處。
refs.text_en: The spirit of man is the lamp of Jehovah, / Searching all the innermost parts of the inner being.

refs.text_gb: 神是灵；敬拜祂的，必须在灵和真实里敬拜。
refs.text_big5: 神是靈；敬拜祂的，必須在靈和真實裏敬拜。
refs.text_en: God is Spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truthfulness.

refs.text_gb: 那灵自己同我们的灵见证我们是神的儿女。
refs.text_big5: 那靈自己同我們的靈見證我們是神的兒女。
refs.text_en: The Spirit Himself witnesses with our spirit that we are children of God.

refs.text_gb: 我在祂儿子的福音上，在我灵里所事奉的神，可以见证我怎样在祷告中，常常不住地提到你们，
refs.text_big5: 我在祂兒子的福音上，在我靈裏所事奉的神，可以見證我怎樣在禱告中，常常不住的題到你們，
refs.text_en: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the gospel of His Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

refs.text_gb: 因为我若用方言祷告，我的灵就祷告，我的心思却没有作用。
refs.text_big5: 因為我若用方言禱告，我的靈就禱告，我的心思卻沒有作用。
refs.text_en: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

refs.text_gb: 这却怎么样？我要用灵祷告，也要用心思祷告；我要用灵歌唱，也要用心思歌唱。
refs.text_big5: 這卻怎麼樣？我要用靈禱告，也要用心思禱告；我要用靈歌唱，也要用心思歌唱。
refs.text_en: What then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray also with the mind; I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing also with the mind.

refs.text_gb: 不然，你若用灵祝福，在场那不通方言的人，既然不晓得你所说的，怎能在你感谢的时候说阿们？
refs.text_big5: 不然，你若用靈祝福，在場那不通方言的人，既然不曉得你所說的，怎能在你感謝的時候說阿們？
refs.text_en: Otherwise if you bless with the spirit, how shall he who fills the place of the unlearned in tongues say the Amen at your giving of thanks, since he does not know what you are saying?

refs.text_gb: 他们使我和你们的灵都畅快。这样的人你们务要赏识。
refs.text_big5: 他們使我和你們的靈都暢快。這樣的人你們務要賞識。
refs.text_en: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Acknowledge therefore such ones.

refs.text_gb: 所以我们得了安慰，并且在这安慰之外，我们因提多的喜乐，就越发更加喜乐，因他的灵从你们众人得了畅快。
refs.text_big5: 所以我們得了安慰，並且在這安慰之外，我們因提多的喜樂，就越發更加喜樂，因他的靈從你們眾人得了暢快。
refs.text_en: Because of this we have been comforted. And in addition to our comfort, we rejoiced more abundantly over the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.

crossrefs.raw: 路十七33，约十二25与注1，来十39与注3，彼前一9

refs.text_gb: 凡想要保全魂生命的，必丧失魂生命；凡丧失魂生命的，必使魂生命得以存活。
refs.text_big5: 凡想要保全魂生命的，必喪失魂生命；凡喪失魂生命的，必使魂生命得以存活。
refs.text_en: Whoever seeks to preserve his soul-life will lose it, and whoever loses it will preserve it alive.

refs.text_gb: 爱惜自己魂生命的，就丧失魂生命；在这世上恨恶自己魂生命的，就要保守魂生命归入永远的生命。
refs.text_big5: 愛惜自己魂生命的，就喪失魂生命；在這世上恨惡自己魂生命的，就要保守魂生命歸入永遠的生命。
refs.text_en: He who loves his soul-life loses it; and he who hates his soul-life in this world shall keep it unto eternal life.

refs.text_gb: 我们却不是退缩以致遭毁坏的人，乃是有信心以致得着魂的人。
refs.text_big5: 我們卻不是退縮以致遭毀壞的人，乃是有信心以致得著魂的人。
refs.text_en: But we are not of those who shrink back to ruin but of those who have faith to the gaining of the soul.

refs.text_gb: 得着你们信心的结果，就是魂的救恩。
refs.text_big5: 得著你們信心的結果，就是魂的救恩。
refs.text_en: Receiving the end of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

refs.text_gb: 然而那叫耶稣从死人中复活者的灵，若住在你们里面，那叫基督从死人中复活的，也必借着祂住在你们里面的灵，赐生命给你们必死的身体。
refs.text_big5: 然而那叫耶穌從死人中復活者的靈，若住在你們裏面，那叫基督從死人中復活的，也必藉著祂住在你們裏面的靈，賜生命給你們必死的身體。
refs.text_en: And if the Spirit of the One who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, He who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit who indwells you.

refs.text_gb: 因为你们若照肉体活着，必要死；但你们若靠着那灵治死身体的行为，必要活着。
refs.text_big5: 因為你們若照肉體活著，必要死；但你們若靠著那靈治死身體的行為，必要活著。
refs.text_en: For if you live according to the flesh, you must die, but if by the Spirit you put to death the practices of the body, you will live.

refs.text_gb: 所以弟兄们，我借着神的怜恤劝你们，将身体献上，当作圣别并讨神喜悦的活祭，这是你们合理的事奉。
refs.text_big5: 所以弟兄們，我藉著神的憐恤勸你們，將身體獻上，當作聖別並討神喜悅的活祭，這是你們合理的事奉。
refs.text_en: I exhort you therefore, brothers, through the compassions of God to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, well pleasing to God, which is your reasonable service.

refs.text_gb: 食物是为肚腹，肚腹是为食物；但这两样，神都要废掉。可是身体不是为淫乱，乃是为主，主也是为身体。
refs.text_big5: 食物是為肚腹，肚腹是為食物；但這兩樣，神都要廢掉。可是身體不是為淫亂，乃是為主，主也是為身體。
refs.text_en: Foods are for the stomach, and the stomach for foods; but God will bring to nought both it and them. But the body is not for fornication but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

refs.text_gb: 岂不知你们的身体是基督的肢体么？我可以把基督的肢体作成娼妓的肢体么？绝对不可！
refs.text_big5: 豈不知你們的身體是基督的肢體麼？我可以把基督的肢體作成娼妓的肢體麼？絕對不可！
refs.text_en: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? Absolutely not!

refs.text_gb: 岂不知你们的身体，就是在你们里面之圣灵的殿么？这圣灵是你们从神而得的，并且你们不是属自己的，
refs.text_big5: 豈不知你們的身體，就是在你們裏面之聖靈的殿麼？這聖靈是你們從神而得的，並且你們不是屬自己的，
refs.text_en: Or do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit within you, whom you have from God, and you are not your own?

refs.text_gb: 我们主耶稣来临的时候，我们在祂面前的盼望、喜乐、或所夸的冠冕是什么？不就是你们么？
refs.text_big5: 我們主耶穌來臨的時候，我們在祂面前的盼望、喜樂、或所誇的冠冕是甚麼？不就是你們麼？
refs.text_en: For what is our hope or joy or crown of boasting before our Lord Jesus at His coming? Are not even you?

refs.text_gb: 好使你们的心，当我们主耶稣同祂众圣徒来临的时候，在我们的神与父面前，得以坚固，在圣别上无可指摘。
refs.text_big5: 好使你們的心，當我們主耶穌同祂眾聖徒來臨的時候，在我們的神與父面前，得以堅固，在聖別上無可指摘。
refs.text_en: So that He may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints.

refs.text_gb: 我们现在凭着主的话，告诉你们这件事，就是我们这些活着还存留到主来临的人，绝不能在那已经睡了的人之先；
refs.text_big5: 我們現在憑著主的話，告訴你們這件事，就是我們這些活著還存留到主來臨的人，絕不能在那已經睡了的人之先；
refs.text_en: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are living, who are left remaining unto the coming of the Lord, shall by no means precede those who have fallen asleep;

refs.text_gb: 因为主必亲自从天降临，有发令的呼叫，有天使长的声音，又有神的号声，那在基督里死了的人必先复活，
refs.text_big5: 因為主必親自從天降臨，有發令的呼叫，有天使長的聲音，又有神的號聲，那在基督裏死了的人必先復活，
refs.text_en: Because the Lord Himself, with a shout of command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet of God, will descend from heaven, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，关于我们主耶稣基督的来临，和我们聚集到祂那里，
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，關於我們主耶穌基督的來臨，和我們聚集到祂那裏，
refs.text_en: Now we ask you, brothers, with regard to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to Him,

refs.text_gb: 那时这不法者必显露出来，主耶稣要用祂口中的气除灭他，并用祂来临的显现废掉他。
refs.text_big5: 那時這不法者必顯露出來，主耶穌要用祂口中的氣除滅他，並用祂來臨的顯現廢掉他。
refs.text_en: And then the lawless one will be revealed (whom the Lord Jesus will slay by the breath of His mouth and bring to nothing by the manifestation of His coming),

refs.text_gb: 使你们无可指摘、纯洁无杂，在弯曲悖谬的世代中，作神无瑕疵的儿女；你们在其中好像发光之体显在世界里，
refs.text_big5: 使你們無可指摘、純潔無雜，在彎曲悖謬的世代中，作神無瑕疵的兒女；你們在其中好像發光之體顯在世界裏，
refs.text_en: That you may be blameless and guileless, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverted generation, among whom you shine as luminaries in the world,

refs.text_gb: 所以，亲爱的，你们既期待这些事，就当殷勤，得在平安中给主看为无斑点、无瑕疵的；
refs.text_big5: 所以，親愛的，你們既期待這些事，就當殷勤，得在平安中給主看為無斑點、無瑕疵的；
refs.text_en: Therefore, beloved, since you expect these things, be diligent to be found by Him in peace without spot and without blemish;

verses.text_gb: 那召[Cra]你们的是信[Crb]实的，祂也[Fn1]必作[Crc]成这事。
verses.text_big5: 那召[Cra]你們的是信[Crb]實的，祂也[Fn1]必作[Crc]成這事。
verses.text_en: Faithful is He who calls you, who also will do it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那召你们的是信实的，祂也必作成这事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那召你們的是信實的，祂也必作成這事。

footnotes.zh: 信实的神召了我们，也必要全然圣别我们，并保守我们全人得以完全。
footnotes.zh_big5: 信實的神召了我們，也必要全然聖別我們，並保守我們全人得以完全。
footnotes.en: 5:24 1 also The faithful God who called us will also sanctify us wholly and preserve our entire being complete.

refs.text_gb: 要叫你们行事为人，配得过那召你们进入祂自己的国和荣耀的神。
refs.text_big5: 要叫你們行事為人，配得過那召你們進入祂自己的國和榮耀的神。
refs.text_en: So that you might walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.

refs.text_gb: 但主是信实的，祂要坚固你们，并保护你们脱离那恶者。
refs.text_big5: 但主是信實的，祂要堅固你們，並保護你們脫離那惡者。
refs.text_en: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

refs.text_gb: 神是信实的，你们乃是为祂所召，进入了祂儿子我们主耶稣基督的交通。
refs.text_big5: 神是信實的，你們乃是為祂所召，進入了祂兒子我們主耶穌基督的交通。
refs.text_en: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

refs.text_gb: 那临到你们的试诱，无非是人所能受的；神是信实的，必不容你们受试诱过于所能受的，祂也必随着试诱开一条出路，叫你们能忍受得住。
refs.text_big5: 那臨到你們的試誘，無非是人所能受的；神是信實的，必不容你們受試誘過於所能受的，祂也必隨著試誘開一條出路，叫你們能忍受得住。
refs.text_en: No temptation has taken you except that which is common to man; and God is faithful, who will not allow that you be tempted beyond what you are able, but will, with the temptation, also make the way out, that you may be able to endure it.

refs.text_gb: 我深信那在你们里面开始了善工的，必完成这工，直到基督耶稣的日子。
refs.text_big5: 我深信那在你們裏面開始了善工的，必完成這工，直到基督耶穌的日子。
refs.text_en: Being confident of this very thing, that He who has begun in you a good work will complete it until the day of Christ Jesus;

verses.text_gb: 弟兄们，请为我们祷[Cra]告。
verses.text_big5: 弟兄們，請為我們禱[Cra]告。
verses.text_en: Brothers, pray also for us.
verses.text_gb_plain: 弟兄们，请为我们祷告。
verses.text_big5_plain: 弟兄們，請為我們禱告。

refs.text_gb: 末了的话，弟兄们，请你们为我们祷告，好叫主的话快快传开，且得荣耀，正如在你们中间一样；
refs.text_big5: 末了的話，弟兄們，請你們為我們禱告，好叫主的話快快傳開，且得榮耀，正如在你們中間一樣；
refs.text_en: Finally, brothers, pray concerning us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified, even as it is also with you;

refs.text_gb: 同时也要为我们祷告，求神给我们开传道的门，能以讲说基督的奥秘，（我也为此被捆锁，）
refs.text_big5: 同時也要為我們禱告，求神給我們開傳道的門，能以講說基督的奧祕，（我也為此被捆鎖，）
refs.text_en: Praying at the same time for us also, that God would open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ (because of which also I am bound),

refs.text_gb: 请你们为我们祷告，因我们深信自己良心无亏，愿意凡事都行得好。
refs.text_big5: 請你們為我們禱告，因我們深信自己良心無虧，願意凡事都行得好。
refs.text_en: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring in all things to conduct ourselves honorably.

verses.text_gb: 你们要用圣别的亲[Cra]嘴问众弟兄安。
verses.text_big5: 你們要用聖別的親[Cra]嘴問眾弟兄安。
verses.text_en: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们要用圣别的亲嘴问众弟兄安。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要用聖別的親嘴問眾弟兄安。

refs.text_gb: 你们要用圣别的亲嘴彼此问安。基督的众召会都问你们安。
refs.text_big5: 你們要用聖別的親嘴彼此問安。基督的眾召會都問你們安。
refs.text_en: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ greet you.

verses.text_gb: 我指着主吩咐你们，要把这信念[Cra]给众[Fn1]弟兄听。
verses.text_big5: 我指著主吩咐你們，要把這信念[Cra]給眾[Fn1]弟兄聽。
verses.text_en: I adjure you by the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我指着主吩咐你们，要把这信念给众弟兄听。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我指著主吩咐你們，要把這信念給眾弟兄聽。

footnotes.zh: 有些古卷上加“圣别的，”意指本书信与信徒圣别的生活有关，因此使徒在结语的嘱咐里，就称信徒为圣别的众弟兄。
footnotes.zh_big5: 有些古卷上加“聖別的，”意指本書信與信徒聖別的生活有關，因此使徒在結語的囑咐裏，就稱信徒為聖別的眾弟兄。
footnotes.en: 5:27 1 brothers Some MSS insert holy. This would mean that, since this Epistle is concerned with the holy life of the believers, the apostle in his concluding charge called the believers "the holy brothers."

refs.text_gb: 这书信在你们中间念了之后，务要叫在老底嘉的召会也念，你们也要念从老底嘉来的书信。
refs.text_big5: 這書信在你們中間念了之後，務要叫在老底嘉的召會也念，你們也要念從老底嘉來的書信。
refs.text_en: And when this letter is read among you, cause that it be read in the church of the Laodiceans also, and that you also read the one from Laodicea.

verses.text_gb: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩[Fn1][Cra]与你们同在。
verses.text_big5: 願我們主耶穌基督的恩[Fn1][Cra]與你們同在。
verses.text_en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩与你们同在。
verses.text_big5_plain: 願我們主耶穌基督的恩與你們同在。

footnotes.zh: 见约一14注4，17注1，林前十五10注1。我们惟有享受主作恩典，才能为着召会生活过圣别的生活，就是凭着主作生命的供应，而有真实、正确为着召会的生活。 本书是为着召会的生活，启发圣别的生活。圣别就是圣。宇宙间惟有神是圣的，是与一切有别而不同的，是不凡俗的，因而是不俗污的。这样的圣乃是神的性情，是神属性中的一个内在特征。所以要完全圣别，整个圣别，不仅在外面的地位上圣别，且在里面的性质上圣别，就必须有神那具有特征的圣别性情。要有神这神圣的性情，也就必须有神，得着神作我们的生命和性情。惟有神能全然圣别我们，能保守我们的灵与魂与身子全人脱离凡俗、不沾俗污、得以完全。神愿意，也必亲自这样圣别我们，只要我们肯追求祂这圣别(来十二14上)，肯在这事上与祂合作。如此，我们就能圣别，像祂圣别一样(彼前一15～16)。我们非如此圣别，就不能见祂(来十二14下)。 神圣别我们，不只用基督救赎我们的血(来十三12，十29)在地位上圣别我们，且用祂自己那圣别的性情在性质上圣化我们。祂这样圣化我们，也就是在我们灵、魂、体的素质里变化我们，使我们在性质上全然像祂。如此，祂就保守我们的灵、魂、体全然完全。祂在地位上圣别我们，是在我们身外的；祂在性质上圣化我们，是在我们身内的，从我们深处的灵起始，经过我们居间的魂，达到我们外观的体。这对我们是深入的，是借着祂赐生命的灵重生我们的灵(约三6)，变化我们的魂(罗十二2)，并救赎我们的体(罗八23，弗四30)，而作成的。这样圣别又圣化的生活，是我们过召会生活，使神喜悦并得彰显，所必需的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見約一14註4，17註1，林前十五10註1。我們惟有享受主作恩典，纔能為著召會生活過聖別的生活，就是憑著主作生命的供應，而有真實、正確為著召會的生活。ˍ本書是為著召會的生活，啟發聖別的生活。聖別就是聖。宇宙間惟有神是聖的，是與一切有別而不同的，是不凡俗的，因而是不俗污的。這樣的聖乃是神的性情，是神屬性中的一個內在特徵。所以要完全聖別，整個聖別，不僅在外面的地位上聖別，且在裏面的性質上聖別，就必須有神那具有特徵的聖別性情。要有神這神聖的性情，也就必須有神，得著神作我們的生命和性情。惟有神能全然聖別我們，能保守我們的靈、與魂、與身子全人脫離凡俗、不沾俗污、得以完全。神願意，也必親自這樣聖別我們，只要我們肯追求祂這聖別，（來十二14上，）肯在這事上與祂合作。如此，我們就能聖別，像祂聖別一樣。（彼前一15～16。）我們非如此聖別，就不能見祂。（來十二14下。）ˍ神聖別我們，不只用基督救贖我們的血（來十三12，十29）在地位上聖別我們，且用祂自己那聖別的性情在性質上聖化我們。祂這樣聖化我們，也就是在我們靈、魂、體的素質裏變化我們，使我們在性質上全然像祂。如此，祂就保守我們的靈、魂、體全然完全。祂在地位上聖別我們，是在我們身外的；祂在性質上聖化我們，是在我們身內的，從我們深處的靈起始，經過我們居間的魂，達到我們外觀的體。這對我們是深入的，是藉著祂賜生命的靈重生我們的靈，（約三6，）變化我們的魂，（羅十二2，）並救贖我們的體，（羅八23，弗四30，）而作成的。這樣聖別又聖化的生活，是我們過召會生活，使神喜悅並得彰顯，所必需的。
footnotes.en: 5:28 1 grace See note John 1:14 6 and note John 1:17 1 and note 1 Cor. 15:10 1 . It is only when we enjoy the Lord as grace that we can live a holy life for the church life, a life that is genuine and proper for the church, lived by our having the Lord as the life supply. In this book the holy life for the church life is developed. To be sanctified is to be holy. In the universe, only God is holy; only He is distinct and different from all other things. He is not common and therefore is undefiled. Holiness is God's nature; it is an intrinsic characteristic of God's attributes. Therefore, to be holy completely and entirely, to be holy not only in outward position but also in inward disposition, we must have the holy nature that is characteristic of God. To have this divine nature of God, we must possess God, having Him as our life and nature. Only God can sanctify us wholly and can preserve our entire being, our spirit and soul and body, complete, keeping it from being common or defiled. God desires to sanctify us, and He Himself will do it, as long as we are willing to pursue Him as holiness (Heb. 12:14a) and cooperate with Him in this matter. In this way we can be holy as He is holy (1 Pet. 1:15-16). Without holiness we cannot see Him (Heb. 12:14b). God not only has made us holy in position by the redeeming blood of Christ (Heb. 13:12; 10:29) but also is sanctifying us in disposition by His own holy nature. By thus sanctifying us, He transforms us in the essence of our spirit, soul, and body, making us wholly like Him in nature. In this way He preserves our spirit, soul, and body wholly complete. His making us holy in position is outside of us, whereas His sanctifying us in disposition is within us, beginning from our spirit, the deepest part, passing through our soul, the intermediate part, and reaching to our body, the outer part. This work, which penetrates us deeply, is accomplished through the regeneration of our spirit (John 3:6), the transformation of our soul (Rom. 12:2), and the redemption of our body (Rom. 8:23; Eph. 4:30) by God's life-giving Spirit. Such a holy and sanctified life is necessary for us to have a church life that is pleasing to God and that expresses Him.

refs.text_gb: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩与你们众人同在。
refs.text_big5: 願我們主耶穌基督的恩與你們眾人同在。
refs.text_en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

refs.text_gb: 平安的神快要将撒但践踏在你们的脚下。愿我们主耶稣的恩，与你们同在。
refs.text_big5: 平安的神快要將撒但踐踏在你們的腳下。願我們主耶穌的恩，與你們同在。
refs.text_en: Now the God of peace will crush Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，愿我们主耶稣基督的恩与你们的灵同在。阿们。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，願我們主耶穌基督的恩與你們的靈同在。阿們。
refs.text_en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
